what: NEW: two drum tracks. Four synths (one a Minimoog-style MUUG with 100 sounds, plus a light LITE synth) and two drum kits play at once, and the FM-1 records 8 channels into your DAW over USB: the stereo master plus each of the six tracks. A SLOOP 2.8 groovebox with the fixes of 2.8.4, 64 steps, songs, punch-in effects and USB MIDI.
